name: Reiss
source: Part Himalayan, part human. Reiss is hot-headed and a true alpha-male. Despite his brazen foolhardiness and mischievous nature, he cares deeply for his two brothers. Can you break through his thorny exterior, revealing the soft heart within?⁠
